entities.span: Replace the flat one row per job history with nested roles containing sub projects.
rejected_spans: so a research assistant project stops having to masquerade as a standalone employer

entities.span: Adds honest completeness signalling: say what is actually missing, not a vague percentage.

Also brings resume upload with extraction, with its accuracy limits shown rather than assumed; that upload is what covers "a resume should fill in a profile", it is not a missing feature on top of it.

And replaces the one value per line textarea for skills, desired titles and desired locations with a chip input: type a value, press Enter, it becomes a chip with an x to remove it. All three fields change together
rejected_spans: since they call the same `newlineList` parser in `src/features/profile/schemas.ts` and behave identically today; changing only skills would make the other two diverge for no reason

entities.span: **Done when:** a role can contain sub projects and renders correctly,
completeness names the specific missing pieces,
extraction results are shown for review before being saved,
the migration from the flat shape loses nothing,
and skills, desired titles and desired locations are entered as chips rather than a line per value.
Implementation constraint for the design pass: a value can contain commas, "Chicago, IL" is a real desired location, so the chip control must commit on Enter only and never split on commas
rejected_spans: which is the usual default in chip components and would break that one value into two

entities.span: Resume upload here overwrites the master resume (feature 24) outright; there is no merge and no second version kept beside it.
